name: BRLA Digital
oneLiner: BRLA is Avenia's centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, mint/redeemed 1:1 for BRL and backed by Brazilian government bonds and BRL cash in regulated custody.
collateral: Brazilian government bonds (titulos publicos) and BRL cash held in regulated custody in Brazil; reserves audited monthly by a third-party firm with attestations published on a transparency page
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 peg to the Brazilian Real; mint/redeem 1:1 for BRL through Avenia (formerly BRLA Digital) platform after KYC; native multichain deployment without wrapping or bridge dependencies

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: Brazilian government bonds and BRL cash in regulated custody

mintAuthority.summary: BRLA is issued by Avenia (formerly BRLA Digital); after KYC, users mint and redeem 1:1 for BRL through the issuer's centralized platform, backed by Brazilian government bonds and BRL cash in regulated custody.

controls.label: Avenia issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Avenia creates BRLA supply against custodied BRL bonds and cash and redeems 1:1 for BRL after KYC; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists across its native multichain deployments.

review.evidence: BRLA materials describe a single issuer (Avenia) minting BRLA against off-chain Brazilian government bonds and BRL cash in regulated custody, with monthly attestations; mint/redeem is KYC-gated and centralized.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer model established from project materials; on-chain token owner/minter admins across Polygon, Gnosis, Celo, and Moonbeam not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain token owner/minter admin across Polygon, Gnosis, Celo, and Moonbeam before raising confidence.
